finalMessage:
Perfect! The app is built and working. The smoke test confirms: - ✅ Form is present (#note-form) - ✅ Feed is present (#feed) - ✅ All 6 seed notes are rendering correctly ## Implementation Summary I've built the Porto Notes app with all required features: **Core Features:** - Add notes with title, rich-text body, and optional avatar URL - Notes display newest-first in the feed - Search filters notes by title/body (case-insensitive) - Deep linking via URL fragments (`#q=search¬e=id`) - LocalStorage persistence with fixtures.json as seed data **Element Contract (for automated tests):** - `#note-form` with `#title`, `#body`, `#avatar` inputs - `#search` input with `#results-line` for "results for..." display - `#feed` section with `.note` articles (each has `data-note-id`) - `.note-title`, `.note-body`, `.note-avatar` elements - Selected notes get `aria-current="true"` **Rich Text Support:** - Handles ``, ``, ``, ``, ``, and `
` tags - Newlines in textarea automatically become line breaks The production build is ready in `dist/` and can be served as static files.
